items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: We was on the train once and they were gambling, and Ivie Anderson was in the game.

ctx.x: And he wouldn't tell him anything anymore then (unintelligible). And he wouldn't trouble Cootie.

We was on the train once and they were gambling, and Ivie Anderson was in the game. So she was always lucky. She'd win. But she did something to Cootie, so -- remember those old things they used to raise the windows up? They had to put it under something and jack it up, like to raise it up? -- so Cootie took one of them things and just looked at her, bam, hit her right in the head. And she had a big gash.

So now she's going to kill Cootie. So the train stopped in El Paso, Texas, and it stays there for a while, you know, and she got off there and she went and bought a gun somewhere. She came back, and I told Cootie, 'Cool it.' I said, 'I think she's got something in that bag.' He said,
